messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - elevated 5xx rate on hosted /v1/generate in us-west-2. Error spike observed at 03:12 UTC. Attaching initial traces and log pointers.
Alex (oncall): On it. Joining war room. Starting triage. :rotating_light: 
Maria (sre): Seeing a sudden jump in 502/504 and tail latency. Repro on internal canary. Kernel OOMs on a subset of runtime pods.
Jamie (eng-runtime): I can repro against canary load. Logs show repeated kv cache allocation failures followed by process kills. Snippet: 

```
OOM killed process 3245 (redwood-runtime)
2026-03-15T03:14:12Z ERROR kv_cache: allocation failed
```

Alex (oncall): Handoff plan: 1) mitigate customer impact, 2) stabilize nodes, 3) collect artifacts for RCA. Paging infra and runtime.
Taylor (comms): Need a short status page initial update we can publish ASAP. Drafting below.
Priya (support): ~6 active customer tickets showing timeouts and retries. I'll prepare targeted outreach once scope confirmed.
Taylor (comms): DRAFT STATUSPAGE COPY (for review):

[Investigating] Elevated error rates and timeouts for text generation in US-West-2

Impact: Some customers may experience request failures (502/504) or increased latency when calling the generation endpoint. Affected subset: hosted deployments in us-west-2.

Current status: Engineering investigating. Mitigation steps being applied (routing to fallback model variants, restarts of impacted nodes).

Next update: in 15 minutes or earlier.

Jamie (eng-runtime): Please call out affected model variants (gpt-small-3, gpt-medium-3). That helps support routing and customer comms.
Taylor (comms): Updated to include models and SLA note.

Alex (oncall): Mitigation actions: enable degraded mode (route to cached responses and smaller model fallback), rolling restarts starting now on 6/8 pods. Monitoring CPU/memory.
Maria (sre): Confirming restarts lowered OOMs on 3/6 restarted pods. Error rate dropped from ~12% to ~3% in 6min, tail latency still elevated.
Jamie (eng-runtime): Deploying temp config to disable KV cache prefetch on startup to reduce peak memory.
Taylor (comms): DRAFT STATUSPAGE COPY v2 (ready to publish after ack):

[Investigating] Elevated error rates for text generation in US-West-2

Impact: Some customers may experience failed requests (502/504) or increased latency for generation endpoints. Affected models: gpt-small-3, gpt-medium-3 on hosted tier in US-West-2.

User impact: ~10% of requests from the affected region experienced errors at peak. No customer data loss.

Mitigation: Traffic routed to fallback model variants and impacted nodes restarted; additional tuning in progress.

Workaround: If affected, customers can set model=gpt-small-2 or use region us-east-1 temporarily.

Next update: in 15 minutes or when service stabilizes.

Taylor (comms): React with :thumbsup: to publish.
Priya (support): :thumbsup: from support ops. Will prepare outbound messages post-publish.
Alex (oncall): :thumbsup: publish.
Taylor (comms): Publishing to status page now and queuing customer outreach to top affected accounts.
ops-bot: StatusPage publish event: page_id=inc-20260315-001, status=investigating, author=Taylor
Maria (sre): Monitoring — error rate trending down to ~1.2%.
Jamie (eng-runtime): Config change rolled to all targeted pods at 03:28 UTC; tail latency ~200ms above baseline. Working on kernel memory alloc tuning for next rollout.
Taylor (comms): Published initial public update. Preparing the periodic update for +30.
Alex (oncall): Next updates scheduled: +15 (mitigation metrics) and +45 (resolve/ETA). Handoff to Maria in 20 minutes; Maria will lead next phase.
Maria (sre): Acknowledged handoff. Owning subsequent updates and coordination with Jamie.
Priya (support): Outbound customer messages are queued; will send once error rate <1% sustained for 10m.
Taylor (comms): FOLLOW-UP DRAFT for next update (metrics):

[Update] Error rates decreased; mitigation ongoing

Status: Restarts and routing changes applied. Error rate reduced from 12% peak to ~1.2%. Some elevated latency remains.

What we're doing: Kernel memory tuning rollout to remaining pods; provisioning extra capacity.

Next update: in 30 minutes or when resolved.

Maria (sre): :thumbsup: publish when metrics steady for 5m.
Jamie (eng-runtime): Kernel tuning staged; rollout to begin in 10m.
Taylor (comms): Published follow-up.
ops-bot: StatusPage update event: page_id=inc-20260315-001, status=investigating, author=Taylor, update_seq=2
Alex (oncall): Handoff complete, shifting to standby. Thanks team.
Maria (sre): Kernel tuning complete, error rate stable at 0.2% for 12m. Initiating resolve checks.
Jamie (eng-runtime): Memory pressure normalized, no OOMs in last 20m. Rolling back degraded routing.
Taylor (comms): DRAFT RESOLVE NOTICE:

[Resolved] Elevated error rates for text generation in US-West-2

Summary: Engineering investigation and mitigations (service restarts, fallback routing, kernel memory tuning) resolved the issue affecting gpt-small-3 and gpt-medium-3 in US-West-2. Error rates returned to baseline (<0.5%) and memory pressure is normal.

Customer impact: Some customers experienced transient request failures and latency between 03:12–03:40 UTC. No data loss. If you continue to see issues, contact support.

Timeline: Detected 03:12 UTC; mitigations applied 03:18–03:28 UTC; resolved 03:40 UTC.

If you want a post-incident report, reply to this thread or file an RCA request.

Priya (support): :thumbsup: will send resolve notices to affected customers now.
Taylor (comms): Publishing resolve notice and closing page.
ops-bot: StatusPage final event: page_id=inc-20260315-001, status=resolved, author=Taylor
Alex (oncall): Closing loop — thanks all. Logs and artifacts uploaded for RCA.
Maria (sre): Uploading traces and OOM logs to incident ticket.
Jamie (eng-runtime): Noting KV cache prefetch as likely contributing factor; will propose permanent fix via PR.
Taylor (comms): Final: resolve posted, customer messages sent. Good work. :tada:
Priya (support): Closing customer tickets where applicable and adding follow-up notes.
